newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway debt gap to Bunds widen on CPI forecast.
newsitem.headline: Norway debt gap to Bunds widen on CPI forecast.

text.p: 1500 GMT -- Norwegian debt yields rose and the spread to German Bunds widened on a higher-than-expected inflation forecast by the central bank, dealers said.
"Today's market was driven by domestic matters," one said.

The central bank projected inflation at between 2.75 percent and 3.0 percent this year, up from 2.5 percent in a similar inflation report three months ago. This contrasted with a Statistics Office forecast last month of 1.8 percent for this year.
The crown stood at 4.01 against the mark.
* 2007 bond yield eight basis points higher at 6.16 pct
* Norway over Bunds gap seven points wider at 26 points
* Three-month eurokrone two basis point higher at 3.51 pct
